title: Stance in Transport Debates
text:
Many city planners claim that new bus lanes are an obvious improvement. However, the phrase 'obvious improvement' hides a strong opinion, since drivers may lose time and businesses may lose customers. A careful writer would instead say that the lanes appear to be beneficial, which signals that the claim is still open to debate.

Language of stance also appears in questions. Asking 'Why would anyone oppose such a sensible plan?' is not really a question at all; it is a way of criticising people who disagree. Readers who notice this rhetorical device can see that the writer has already decided the answer.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what might drivers lose because of the new bus lanes?
According to the second paragraph, what is the question 'Why would anyone oppose such a sensible plan?' really doing?
What does the writer suggest about the phrase 'appear to be beneficial'?
options: It shows that the claim is completely certain
It signals that the claim is open to debate
It is a direct quotation from a city planner
It refers to the cost of fuel

questions.text: Why does the author think readers should notice rhetorical questions?
options: They make the text longer and harder to read
They always show that the writer is wrong
They are used only in legal documents
They can reveal that the writer has already decided the answer

vocabulary.definition: used to persuade or impress rather than to get real information
saying what is wrong with someone or something

paragraph_translations: Birçok şehir planlamacısı, yeni otobüs şeritlerinin açık bir iyileştirme olduğunu iddia ediyor. Ancak 'obvious improvement' ifadesi güçlü bir görüşü gizliyor, çünkü sürücüler zaman kaybedebilir ve işletmeler müşteri kaybedebilir. Dikkatli bir yazar bunun yerine şeritlerin yararlı görünmekte olduğunu söyler; bu da iddianın hâlâ tartışmaya açık olduğunu gösterir.

Duruş dili sorularda da görülür. 'Why would anyone oppose such a sensible plan?' gerçekte bir soru değildir; anlaşmayan insanları eleştirmenin bir yoludur. Bu retorik aracı fark eden okurlar, yazarın cevabı zaten belirlediğini görebilir.
